# tree-sitter-tcl parses every braced word as a script and reports
# errors on shell's `$(...)`, `do ... done` and awk's braces inside it. Tcl
# reads a braced argument literally, so those errors are the grammar
# misreading data: contained in the site's braces, they do not fail the
# file (`languages:V78` applies to errors outside them).
exec sh -c | shell | { | sh | - | "ls $(pwd) | wc -l"
exec bash -c | shell | { | bash | - | "for f in *; do echo \"$f\"; done"
exec sh -c | shell | { | sh | - | "awk '{print $1}' notes"
